Subject: Hold demo during year-end office closure — propose January handoff

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Quick heads-up: we have a GreenBridge Health demo currently scheduled for Tue, Dec 22 at 11:00 AM PT. GreenBridge just flagged a travel conflict for several of their attendees and I realized our company shutdown (Dec 24–Jan 2) makes it risky to run the session and follow up in a timely way.

Proposal: put this demo on hold and rebook for the week of Jan 8 (customer suggested windows below) so we can ensure the right engineering and CS folks are available for Q&A.

Why I recommend holding:
- Several GreenBridge participants (product + security) are traveling the week of the 21st.
- Our post-demo action items (trial onboarding, infra details) would be delayed because many internal owners will be out during the closure.
- We should avoid a partial demo where we can’t answer security questions live.

Options to offer: Jan 8–12 (flexible), with a lightweight executive intro if the customer requests. Can you confirm:
1) Who will own the demo delivery in Jan (presenter + backup)?
2) Whether we should send an official pause note to the customer now or wait for their response?

I attached the latest demo slide draft (v1) for context. I can update and produce a shorter v2 if we decide to push to January.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
